description: Observed public storefront capabilities. Every entry is backed by evidence URLs from the crawl.

features.description: Products are organised into top-level categories, with a nested set of capsule subcategories reachable from the header navigation.
implementationNotes: Two navigation categories are currently empty and still render as valid pages.
features.name: Category browsing

features.description: Brands are first-class: an index page lists every brand, and each brand has its own listing page with a description and product count.
implementationNotes: 15 brands carry products; the index also lists brands with none.
Brand pages filter by category, the inverse of category pages, which filter by brand.
features.name: Brand browsing

features.description: Each product has a detail page with name, image, price, pack size, availability, intensity, a short description, breadcrumbs and related products.
implementationNotes: Some products genuinely have no price and no pack size; both must render gracefully.
features.name: Product detail page

features.description: Listing pages expose filters whose state is encoded in URL search parameters.
implementationNotes: Reference filtering is client-side show/hide over a fully rendered list.
A server-rendered equivalent is required for our storefront so filtered pages are crawlable.
features.name: Catalog filtering

features.description: A promotions route lists products carrying a reduced price. The capability exists and is currently empty.
implementationNotes: Every observed product has an empty `old_price`, so no promotion is active right now.
The route must render a proper empty state rather than 404.
features.name: Promotions

features.description: Instead of a cart and checkout, each product offers a single phone-number field. The shop calls back to confirm the order.
implementationNotes: There is no cart, no checkout and no payment anywhere on the reference site.
The reference posts to a third-party CMS endpoint; ours must post to our own API and persist locally.
features.name: Quick order by phone

features.description: A footer email field offers a discount in exchange for subscribing.
implementationNotes: Must store consent locally rather than forwarding to the source.
features.name: Newsletter signup

features.description: Product pages show a carousel of other products from the same area of the catalog.
implementationNotes: No explicit relationship is published, so ours is derived from category and brand.
features.name: Related products

features.description: Product pages show shop → category → product.
features.name: Breadcrumb navigation

features.description: A blog route exists and currently has no published articles.
implementationNotes: Capability only; there is no content to mirror.
features.name: Blog

features.description: Privacy policy, general terms and cookie settings are published.
implementationNotes: Content must be written for our business, never copied.
features.name: Legal and policy pages

features.description: A phone number is present in the header and footer as a direct `tel:` link.
features.name: Phone contact
